note: Dillon RD, White River NF: grass sites near the inlet of Green Mountain Reservoir off gravel Heeney Rd (County Rd 30), ~7,950 ft. Motorboats must launch from Heeney Marina after an aquatic-nuisance-species inspection; the reservoir's own boat ramp was closed for 2026 for low water. --Claude

Waterfront (stored lakefront) - re-audit lead: on Esri imagery (taken at drawdown) the dirt loop sits on a sage-grass flat on the west bank of the Blue River inlet channel; the loop's nearest sites are ~100-150 m from the channel and the open reservoir is ~400 m north beyond exposed bed. The campground (7,950 ft) is at about the reservoir's full-pool level, so at full pool the inlet arm may come close, but no site is shown on an open apron to the water. FS says only 'near the inlet'. WRNF alert (July 13, 2026): 'The boat ramp at Green Mountain Reservoir is closed for the 2026 season for public safety due to low water.' Not changed.
Access: no White River NF alert or order names Heeney Road / County Rd 30; FS directions are I-70 exit 205, CO-9 north 16 mi, left on Heeney Rd, entrance on the right.
Pin 39.8505,-106.2378 is on the campground loop, ~170 m NNW of the FS coordinate 39.849071,-106.23707 (the loop junction). OK.
Status: no closure posted; the 2026 season (to Oct 2) is over.
